item.title: Brown university shooting: DOJ relases video transcripts of shooter's confession; was planning attacks for six semesters
item.description: Federal investigators say Claudio Neves Valente planned the Brown University shooting for at least six semesters before killing two students and later an MIT professor. After his death was confirmed, the Justice Department released video transcripts in which he expressed no remorse, rejected apologies, and described acting deliberately. Authorities recovered the recordings from a New Hampshire storage unit facility officials.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Modi, Maduro and Macron: Trump makes shocking claims about world leaders in fiery GOP speech
item.description: Former US President Donald Trump addressed House GOP members. He spoke about his administration's achievements and made notable remarks about Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, and French President Emmanuel Macron. Trump discussed military operations, weapon production, and international trade agreements. His comments on drug pricing and tariffs involving Macron have drawn significant attention.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Photographer behind one of history’s most tragic images explains why he was helpless to save her
item.description: The photograph of 13-year-old Omayra Sánchez Garzón, trapped in volcanic mud after the 1985 Nevado del Ruiz eruption, became the defining image of Colombia’s deadliest natural disaster. As she spent nearly 60 hours pinned beneath debris, cameras captured her final moments. The photographer later said rescue was impossible, and the image exposed failures in evacuation, leadership and disaster preparedness that cost thousands of lives.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: MrBeast waives copyright for Beast Games Season 2 Episode 1 to boost stream reactions
item.description: MrBeast's 'Beast Games: Strong vs Smart' Season 2 premieres January 7, 2026, on Amazon Prime Video. Episode 1 is copyright-free for streamers on YouTube and Twitch, encouraging reactions and engagement from creators worldwide. A special $50,000 giveaway with JasonTheWeen will also occur, boosting fan participation and visibility for the new season.

item.title: Spanish streamer died after downing whisky and taking cocaine as viewers paid to watch, police say
item.description: Spanish police are investigating the death of 37-year-old streamer Sergio Jiménez, who died during a private New Year’s Eve livestream after allegedly downing whisky and taking cocaine for paying viewers. He was found dead at his family home while the stream continued. Family accounts, police inquiries and parallels with other fatal online challenges have raised questions about responsibility and incitement.

'She was a woman': Candace Owens reacts after French court convicts ten over false online attacks on Brigitte Macron
item.description: Candace Owens criticized France’s cyber-bullying laws after a Paris court convicted ten people for harassing Brigitte Macron online. The court ruled the claims were false and harmful. The case also links to a U.S. defamation lawsuit filed by the Macrons against Owens, accusing her of spreading damaging conspiracy claims for personal gain.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Rapper 6ix9ine begins three-month jail sentence, Adin Ross streams final moments
item.description: Rapper 6ix9ine began a three-month jail sentence on January 6, 2026, for violating supervised release. Streamer Adin Ross broadcasted 6ix9ine's final free moments live. The rapper surrendered at the Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn. This follows multiple violations, including drug possession and assault. Fans watched his check-in process online, thanks to Adin.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: ‘$40-50 billion going away’: Indian-origin journalist Fareed Zakaria warns as Indian students ditch US
item.description: The American dream for Indians is fading as stricter H-1B policies deter students. Fareed Zakaria highlights a significant decline in Indian students choosing the US, with many now opting for more affordable and accessible education in countries like Australia, Canada, and the UK. This shift represents a substantial loss for American universities and global influence.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Giving back: US-based alumnus Mahesh Samdani donates $1 million to BITS Pilani
item.description: BITS Pilani received a significant $1 million donation from alumnus Mahesh Samdani and his wife, Purva Ladha, to establish a new scholarship endowment. Named in memory of Samdani's mother, the fund will support meritorious female students facing financial challenges, beginning in the 2026-27 academic year. This contribution aims to alleviate educational barriers for deserving students.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Bangladesh existence can't be imagined without 1971 war: BNP acting chairperson Tarique Rahman
item.description: BNP acting chairperson Tarique Rahman emphasized the 1971 Liberation War as the bedrock of Bangladesh's existence and politics. He urged national unity and collaboration between government and opposition to leverage the post-election "uprising" for strengthening democracy and building a liberal, welfare-oriented state with people at its core.
item.dc:creator: Ahsan Tasnim

item.title: Venezuelan opposition leader Machado vows to return home 'as soon as possible'
item.description: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado said Monday she plans to return home "as soon as possible," and rejected the authority of the interim president who has replaced Nicolas Maduro in Caracas. The opposition figure also openly rejected the country's interim president Delcy Rodriguez, saying she "is one of the main architects of torture, persecution, corruption, narcotrafficking."

item.title: Vietnam to force YouTube and other platforms to allow skipping ads after 5 seconds starting February 15
item.description: Vietnam is introducing a new law requiring digital platforms like YouTube to allow users to skip ads within five seconds. This change, effective February 15, 2026, aims to create a better online experience. Previously unskippable ads will now be shorter or immediately dismissible. Platforms must also ensure clear ad controls and report illegal content promptly.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Daughter of ‘Skara Cannibal’ speaks about loving her father after he murdered her stepmother
item.description: Jamie-Lee Arrow, daughter of Sweden’s “Skara Cannibal” Isakin Drabbad, speaks about loving her father after he murdered and ate his girlfriend, Helle Christensen. Drawing on interviews and the series Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks, she recounts childhood psychological abuse, a final warning before the killing, and her decision to sever contact while rebuilding her own life with resilience intact.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: Who is BDE? YouTuber turns wrestler as Brandon Collymore signs full-time deal with TNA Wrestling
item.description: Brandon Collymore, known as BDE, has officially signed with TNA Wrestling. The YouTuber turned wrestler confirmed the news in an emotional interview. Nearly one year after his first match, BDE joins TNA full-time after appearing at Bound For Glory and training under Sami Callihan. Fans will now see him compete regularly inside the ring.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: ‘Ghost games’: 456 bags of human remains found near FIFA World Cup stadium in Mexico
item.description: Over 456 bags of human remains were discovered in clandestine graves near Guadalajara's Estadio Akron, a 2026 World Cup venue. These findings, made by civilian search groups and authorities between 2022 and late 2025, highlight Mexico's ongoing crisis of disappearances and violence linked to organized crime, with Jalisco being a particularly affected state.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Inside Danielle Marsh’s fallout with ADOR and how MrBeast came into the picture following strong fan reactions
item.description: Danielle Marsh’s exit from NewJeans has sparked major backlash against ADOR, with fans demanding accountability and support for the former idol. The controversy escalated after YouTube star MrBeast responded to fan pleas asking him to help Danielle. His brief comment fueled online campaigns, turning a K-pop contract dispute into a global social media moment.
